CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION calculate_tes(
    txkey INT
)
RETURNS FLOAT AS $ $
DECLARE
    total_engagement_score FLOAT;
    total_sessions INT;
BEGIN
    -- Fetch the therapy details for the given treatment
    SELECT
        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN therapy_details ->> 'engagement' = 'High' THEN 3
                WHEN therapy_details ->> 'engagement' = 'Medium' THEN 2
                WHEN therapy_details ->> 'engagement' = 'Low' THEN 1
                WHEN therapy_details ->> 'engagement' = 'Non-compliant' THEN 0
                ELSE 0 -- Default case for any unexpected values
            END
        ) AS total_score,
        COUNT(*) AS session_count
    INTO
        total_engagement_score,
        total_sessions
    FROM
        treatmentbasics
    WHERE
        txkey = txkey;

    -- Calculate the average engagement score
    IF total_sessions > 0 THEN
        RETURN total_engagement_score / total_sessions;
    ELSE
        RETURN 0; -- Return 0 if no sessions found
    END IF;
END;
$ $ LANGUAGE plpgsql;
